blocks.text: Junk Cleanout Services in Aurora, Ontario — Any Space, Any Size, Emptied Properly

c: Not every cleanout is a whole house. Sometimes it’s just the garage that finally has to function again. The basement storage room. The shed, the office, the storage unit across town that’s been billing you monthly for boxes nobody misses. Whatever the space and whatever’s in it, the service works the same way: our fully insured Aurora crew walks it with you, quotes one free flat price, and empties it — sorted, hauled and swept — usually the same day.

blocks.text: One Crew for Every Full Space in Aurora — From a Single Shed to a Complete Estate

Aurora keeps us moving between very different doors: a two-car garage in Aurora Highlands that hasn't parked a car in years, a downtown office off Yonge Street changing hands, a storage locker a family inherited along with everything in it, and yes — full houses too. Live Junk Free handles the entire range with the same approach, and the 660+ five-star Google reviews behind our name come from every one of those job types.

items.title: Small space, small price — big space, still one flat price

blocks.text: Volume is the only input. A shed's worth of clutter is a modest load and billed like one; a packed double garage costs more because it fills more truck. No hourly rates, no minimum-job penalties on the small end, no scale surcharges on the large — and no Aurora address pays differently than another.

items.title: Every quote comes from standing inside the space

blocks.text: Full spaces are always fuller than described — the shelf above the workbench, the crawl behind the furnace, the second layer under the tarp. So we look before we number. One free walkthrough of the actual space produces one firm figure, and you're never obliged to take it.

The quote already contains everything: crew, truck, fuel, tipping fees, the donation drop-offs. Whatever the space reveals once we're elbow-deep — heavier, dustier, more of it than anyone thought — the figure you approved is the figure on the receipt.

items.title: We sort like the contents belonged to someone — because they did

blocks.text: Even a "junk" space usually holds a few things that aren't: tools worth keeping, paperwork that matters, the box of photos everyone forgot. Our crews clear by sorting, setting aside anything significant and routing the usable to donation, so nothing important rides out with the genuinely done.

items.title: The walkthrough is free and the pressure is zero

blocks.text: Hear the number, take your time, decide whenever. Approve it and the crew starts on the spot; decline and we leave without a fee; wait a month and the quote's still good. No deposits, no expiry dates, no follow-up campaigns.

items.title: Independent and local — 30–50% under franchise pricing

blocks.text: The national cleanout brands carry royalty fees in every job they quote. We carry none, and Aurora customers keep the difference: typically 30–50% on identical work.
Cleanout Pricing in Aurora, From Shed to Estate
One Scale, One Flat Number, No Games

Small cleanouts start at {{cad_125}} — a closet, a shed, a corner of the garage. Mid-size spaces like basements and full garages land in the middle. Whole homes and estates, even multi-load ones, are still quoted as a single locked figure at the free walkthrough. The scale slides with volume; the certainty never does.
Full Space to Functional Space — the Four-Step Route
Whichever door we're opening, the sequence holds:

items.title: 1. Book It in Minutes
text: Call +1 647 922 5865 or book online. Aurora crews run seven days a week, 6AM to 11PM, same-day slots included, with a 30-minute text before arrival.

items.title: 2. Open the Space, Hear the Number
text: Show us the garage, the basement, the unit, the office — all of it. We assess the true volume and hand over one flat, all-inclusive quote. Free, and "let me think" is always fine.

items.title: 3. Sorted and Carried, Not Shovelled
text: On your go, the crew clears methodically: keep-worthy finds set aside, donations staged separately, disposal loaded last, and every item carried by us — including out of lofts, down ladders and through side doors.

items.title: 4. Swept and Sent On
text: The empty space gets a broom finish. The load gets a conscience: donation partners first, recyclers for metal, wood and e-waste second, and landfill only for what's left after both.

Frequently Asked Questions About Junk Cleanout Services in Aurora, ON

items.q: Q: What do cleanout services cost in Aurora?
a: A: The space’s volume sets it. Small jobs — a shed, a closet, a locker — start at $125; garages and basements typically land mid-range; full homes are quoted as one flat multi-load figure. Every price is confirmed free and in person before work starts, and approved numbers never move.

items.q: Q: Is a single garage or basement too small a job to book?
a: A: Not remotely — single-space cleanouts are the bread and butter of our Aurora schedule. A one-space job books, quotes and finishes the same day more often than not, and the volume pricing keeps it proportionally cheap.

items.q: Q: Can you empty a storage unit so I can stop paying for it?
a: A: Gladly — it’s one of the fastest returns on a phone call we offer. Most units clear in under an hour, get swept for the facility’s final inspection, and the monthly bill ends there. If anything inside looks worth keeping, we’ll flag it before it’s loaded.

items.q: Q: Do you handle offices and commercial spaces, or just homes?
a: A: Both, equally. Office suites, storefronts and back rooms across Aurora get the same treatment as residential jobs — a walkthrough, a flat quote, and a full clear including furniture, filing and e-waste — scheduled around business hours when needed.

items.q: Q: What if we only want part of the house cleared?
a: A: Then that’s the job. Partial cleanouts — one floor, one room, one overwhelming corner — are completely normal bookings, and there’s no penalty or minimum forcing you toward more than you need. Plenty of whole-home clients started with just the garage.
